body.subject: Outage report and lane status: the store refuses every write, the #410 delta and the #188 design are committed and preserved, and eight lanes hold the reassigned issues

items.change: The coordination store refuses every bridge write with ENOSPC and has done so since about 21:10Z: swarm.view, swarm.watch, swarm.update and swarm.notify all answer {code: operational_log_unavailable, message: 'authoritative operational log append failed: ENOSPC: no space left on device, write'}, which runtime-admission.mjs:664 raises around the authoritative operational log append. The volume itself accepts writes: this seat wrote and deleted a 256 MiB probe file in /tmp at 21:47Z with 760 MiB free, and df has moved between 735 MiB and 2.0 GiB across the window, so the store's refusal reads as a latched or bound-writer state rather than a bare lack of space. Nothing this seat can do reaches it: no contribution, review, landing or wake row can be recorded until the resident's store writes again.
items.test: baton swarm.view / swarm.watch / swarm.update / swarm.notify from this worktree; dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/probe bs=1m count=256
items.evidence: the four bridge answers quoted above (21:10Z-21:47Z); the 256 MiB write succeeded and was removed; df -m /private/tmp readings 735-2048 MiB free

items.change: Issue #188's design is committed twice and preserved in this repository: docs/55-failure-stall.md as ac691c01 on branch wake-lead3-188-design (master-based, recorded as contribution-721b24395f40cb6d98efd460402a2244 and reviewed accept by its author), and as b33ba1ca on branch wake-lead3-green-verify (the lane's green verification base plus the same document). The document specifies the count-derived failure-stall fact, the park that never touches a live member, one attention row per park carrying the verdicts and their death certificates, the threshold as operator policy that bounds no action, seven red-first pins (FS-1..FS-7) and the migration.
items.test: git log --oneline -1 wake-lead3-188-design; git log --oneline -1 wake-lead3-green-verify
items.evidence: 121 lines; every cited anchor re-read in the tree before writing (CANONICAL_RUN_PHASES application-semantics.mjs:21-25, APPLICATION_TERMINAL_CANONICAL :108-110, CANONICAL_ATTENTION_KINDS :33-36, projectProgressClass application-observation.mjs:518, the certificates at holistic-runtime.mjs:393 and production-convergence-state.mjs:193, the pinned WAKE_REASONS set test/orchestrator-wake-red.test.mjs:267)

items.change: The #410 delta (contribution-df1200e8, commit c69de1e0) stays staged and preserved: this seat's master-based worktree branch carries it as its only diff against origin/master 65c913f0 (commit 86a638bb, impl/src/application-cli.mjs minus one line), its own judged subset is green (41 passed, 1 expected red #320, 0 unexpected, 0 stale, 0 hung), and the landing retry is `baton swarm integrate swarm-wake-20260921 contribution-df1200e82124149e9ba6dc65184368bf target master`. An integrate with no explicit target refuses 'the target HEAD is not a local branch of this repository' because the resident's checkout is detached at the served commit; name the target explicitly.
items.test: git diff --stat origin/master 86a638bb; node scripts/run-suite.mjs test/surface-cli.test.mjs test/swarm-wake.test.mjs test/issue288-command-pending-receipt.test.mjs test/issue352-recruit-follow-stale-admission.test.mjs
items.evidence: the subset verdict above, run at 20:15Z on 65c913f0 plus the delta; the integrate refusal code integrate_change_invalid with the quoted message

items.change: Eight seats hold the reassigned issues, each with its own work item: sse-attach2 (#320), attention-ledger2 (#255/#249/#108), wait-transport (#445/#164), wave-triage (read-only cluster triage, delivered contribution-595788318a24e1ebc148047601d7dde0), visibility-274 (docs/46 sections 4/5/6), wave-race-65 (the reproduced write race), inbox-71 (the 30-row attention-inbox contract), driver-lanes (#175/#216/#106). The triage's dispositions are recorded in the shared context (key decisions:wake-lane-2026-09-22): #55 needs no code, #175's fix is the direction sentence plus one complement row, #65's write race is reproduced with its fix site, and #188/#50 need designs.
items.test: baton swarm view swarm-wake-20260921 participants (last read before the outage)
items.evidence: eight recruit receipts, all admitted (seqs 87524, 87559, 95131, 96373, 96426, 100661 plus the two originals); wave-triage's contribution recorded at seq 100661's neighbourhood

environmentRed: the coordination store refuses every write with ENOSPC (operational_log_unavailable)
the resident's checkout is detached, so an integrate needs an explicit target

carriedForward: The acceptance verdict is running on the lane's green verification tree (branch wake-lead3-green-verify: the base the predecessor measured green twice, plus the #188 document): `npm test --prefix impl` from this worktree, started 21:50Z. It will be published with its verdict and its base named, because a master-based tree cannot pass while another lane's core-tool closure reds stand (27 unexpected on clean master; the MCP lane's f3ee7df7 takes that to 5 and is not yet landed).

mcp-lead3 reported at 20:52Z that #555's root cause is found - the D4 filter in surface-capability-catalog.mjs erases every served MCP tool name that resolves through a compatibility alias - and that the fix plus verification is running on branch baton/mcp3-555-seedrow. The store outage is what keeps their landing off master, not their code.
needsFromOthers: From the operator or the root: clear the resident's store write path (a resident restart or a store repair) - no contribution, review, landing or wake row can be written while it refuses, so no lane's completed work can reach the remote.

From the operator: space on the Data volume (it touched 125 MiB free at 22:10Z) and a decision on the about twenty stale 122 MiB lane scratch checkouts under /tmp; and a decision on the resident's detached checkout, which forces every integrate to name its target.
